decisions.reason: The margin analysis builds on the maintained market-data base and has its own page, so with no visible shortfall against aspirations in a growing industry there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The gas tariff comparison sits close to the core offer and costs little to run on existing databases, so slack readily carries it.
The regional electricity tariff calculator is a core-adjacent, well-presented product that fits the central platform strategy, so retention meets aspirations.
The energy tariff calculator line is less visible and overlaps with C, which makes consolidation possible, but its several models and low marginal cost favour keeping it.
The area definition tool complements the location-based products on the platform, so its value comes from supporting the integrated offering rather than from standalone results.
The site-specific comparison line uses existing data close to the core business, so despite modest web visibility the slack in a growing market justifies keeping it.
